target: FIFA Street PS3 BLUS30882 / native Windows
hardware_cpu: Intel Core i5-10400F / 6 cores / 12 logical processors
scenario: 90-second opening, no scripted input, keyboard fallback, PERF=1
metric: render_frame batches per second; includes offscreen passes; not displayed gameplay FPS
interactive_observation: 1.2498 renderer batches/s in a separate4s sample; scene not controlled
limitation: Opening-only measurements. Different scenes and unresolved graphics defects prevent a gameplay performance claim.

current_binary.runtime_timer_change: reverted; final SDK runtime source matches baseline

frame_timeline.scope: Representative opening-only trace; flip requests are not proof of presented gameplay FPS.

poll_diagnosis.loop_exits_when: REA/Rizin disassembly at 0x000A7208 compares the first word of *(object+0xC) with zero; the beq at 0x000A720C exits to 0x000A7220 when equal. Nonzero status calls syscall 0x8D with 30 microseconds, then loops.
poll_diagnosis.interpretation: Corrects the prior negative-status interpretation. The wait reads the same EA observed in the PPU/SPU watch: PPU marks it 1, SPU GET sees 1 and post-transfer PUT commits 0, and the helper exits on 0. This confirms a PPU/SPU status handshake; whether its duration alone explains the low flip rate remains unproven.

related_evidence.observation: func_000A8E10 loads the pointer from context+0xC and stores 1 to its first word.
func_000A9680 passes *(caller_object+0x9C) as the helper argument; helper reads its +0xC pointer.

rea_static_disassembly.runtime_correlation: In run 1793103246332528600, the same helper call-site LR 0x000A969C wrote 0x106E0904 and 0x106E0908 while its code used r3=*(object+0xC), establishing r3=0x106E0900 for that observed instance. The publisher wrote 1 to 0x106E0900; SPU post-transfer GET read 1 and PUT committed 0 there.
rea_static_disassembly.limitations: Rizin warned that ELF program headers 2-4 appeared invalid. The requested section address disassembled, but automatic function sizing grouped adjacent routines; rely on the address-scoped instructions, not Rizin's 900-byte function extent or inferred argument list. Rizin pdc returned no pseudocode.

poll_diagnosis.instrumentation: PS3_POLLTOP and PS3_FTRACE enabled; use counts as diagnostic evidence, not an uninstrumented benchmark.

ppu_write_watch.ppu_writes_status_one: func_000A8E10 called from LR 0x000A95DC; observed on TIDs 17 and 22
ppu_write_watch.wait_helper: func_000A71E4, called from func_000A9680 at LR 0x000A969C
ppu_write_watch.scope: PPU_WWATCH only sees guest PPU stores; it does not attribute SPU DMA or raw host writes.

spu_dma_watch.scope: The original watch ran before the MFC command and did not prove committed PUT values. It is superseded by post_transfer_watch below.
spu_dma_watch.interpretation: Pre-transfer records proved only matching requests. This flaw was replaced by the post-transfer watch in patches/0002-post-transfer-spu-watch.patch.

live_memory_sampling.mode: direct execution using the recorded spawn request; EBOOT bypassed for this read-only memory sample
live_memory_sampling.scope: Best-effort ReadProcessMemory snapshots. A transition shorter than the sampling interval is not excluded.
live_memory_sampling.storage_note: This one-off direct launch omitted PS3_HDD0_ROOT/PS3_HDD1_ROOT. It created local trophy files at gamedata/trophies; files were preserved and the root folder is now Git-ignored. Future direct probes must point storage to private/userdata.

follow_up.next: Trace which SPU work at PC 0x0156C owns this 1-to-0 handshake, measure how long status stays nonzero per request, and establish whether the 305628 polls explain the missed flip cadence. Preserve the synchronization; do not force status or skip the wait.

post_transfer_watch.implementation: SPU_WATCHEA logs only after MFC execution; counts matching GET/PUT records, includes rc and source/destination bytes. SPU_WATCHEA_EVERY defaults to 1.
post_transfer_watch.build_note: Target Runtime builds private/build/runtime-clang and is not the archive linked by FullGame. Rebuild the shared archive with tools/build.ps1 -Target Boot, then relink FullGame.
post_transfer_watch.observed_transfer: MFC GET cmd 0x40 transferred status 1 and adjacent word 0x12805080 from EA 0x106E0900. MFC PUT cmd 0x20 committed status 0 and preserved adjacent word 0x12805080. Every logged transfer returned rc=0.
post_transfer_watch.ppu_writer: PPU_WWATCH saw 260 writes of 1 by func_000A8E10, caller LR 0x000A95DC, split across TID17 and TID22. No negative write appeared during the probe.
post_transfer_watch.meaning: The 1-to-0 handshake at 0x106E0900 and the helper's exit-on-zero behavior are corroborated by static disassembly and the same instrumented run. The full SPU job semantics and causal relationship to low flip cadence remain unknown. No menu progression was demonstrated.
post_transfer_watch.limitations: 20s instrumented run, timeout. Diagnostics can perturb scheduling. PC 0x0156C and image 526190333 are observed identifiers, not semantic names. Static mapping shows 0x0156C is a NOP in the identified overlay, so the logged PC is not a proven MFC call site.

spu_pc_provenance.observed_dma_log: private/analysis/runs/1793103742518647900/stderr.log, lines 839-840 and later: image=526190333, pc=0x0156C, MFC GET/PUT to 0x106E0900
spu_pc_provenance.rea_spu_support: REA 6.7.0 Windows provider/Rizin 0.9.1 could not disassemble SPU; Rizin rejected asm.arch=spu and asm.bits=128. Saved diagnostic: private/analysis/rea/rea-spu-rizin-limitation.json.
spu_pc_provenance.interpretation: The runtime PC recorded by the MFC hook does not identify the wrch instruction. Lifted blocks call spu_wrch synchronously without updating ctx->pc for each guest instruction, so it can retain a prior block/interpreter PC. Do not attribute the handshake to code at 0x0156C.
spu_pc_provenance.next_instrumentation: Carry guest instruction address from the SPU lifter to the channel-write hook (at least MFC_Cmd), and log the LS instruction word at that address in the same DMA record. Preserve the transfer and wait semantics.

final_atomic_counter_probe.exit: timeout; native EBOOT-to-FIFAZF spawn observed; no graphics capture
final_atomic_counter_probe.values: Every GET copied 0000000112805080; every PUT committed 0000000012805080; rc=0.
final_atomic_counter_probe.counter: Global hit counter uses __atomic_add_fetch; watch configuration is published with acquire/release atomics.

page_guard_follow_up.result: Rejected as too noisy: PPU_WW_GUARD armed on pointer initialization 0x106E0800, then logged 73,845 writes across a 4 KiB page. Do not repeat unchanged.

timer_experiment.change: one SwitchToThread per sub-millisecond wait, then YieldProcessor while checking the same QPC deadline
timer_experiment.decision: No measurable throughput change; source change reverted and baseline /O1 runtime rebuilt.
